name: sim_z3_capability
purpose: Tool-capability isolation probe for z3 -- unblocks load-bearing SAT/UNSAT use.

pytorch.reason: not used: this Z3 capability fixture exercises SMT solver checks, not tensor autodiff or torch kernels.

pyg.reason: not used: no graph Data object, edge index, message passing, batching, or graph pooling API is exercised.

z3.reason: capability under test -- SAT/UNSAT on small nonclassical encodings

cvc5.reason: not used: this fixture isolates Z3; cvc5 parity and agreement are covered by separate tool-integration receipts.

sympy.reason: not used: formulas are built directly through Z3 constructors rather than symbolic algebra conversion.

clifford.reason: not used: no Clifford basis, multivector product, rotor, or grade projection appears in this SMT fixture.

geomstats.reason: not used: no manifold metric, geodesic, or Lie group geometry API is part of this proof-layer probe.

e3nn.reason: not used: no equivariant neural operation, representation tensor, or learned layer is exercised.

rustworkx.reason: not used: no DAG, graph traversal, shortest path, or dependency graph API is involved.

xgi.reason: not used: no hypergraph incidence, hyperedge membership, or higher-order relation is represented.

toponetx.reason: not used: no cell complex, simplicial complex, Hasse graph, or incidence matrix is exercised.

gudhi.reason: not used: no persistent homology, simplex tree, filtration, or Betti computation is needed.

commutativity_contradiction_unsat.detail: commute AND not-commute must be UNSAT

noncontextuality_bound_unsat.detail: max independent set in C5 is 2; sum>=3 must be UNSAT classically

operation_sequence: construct Boolean, integer, and real Z3 variables
check satisfiability of a Boolean conjunction and read the model
encode a contradiction between commutative and noncommutative integer products
encode a five-cycle binary exclusion bound and require an impossible sum
run adjacent negative fixtures for direct contradiction, tautology satisfiability, and ill-formed mixed Bool/Int construction
run boundary fixtures for empty solver satisfiability, a small linear integer model, and real nonnegativity

carrier_topology.carrier: finite SMT constraint systems over Boolean, integer, and real sorts
boundary_fixtures: real x squared less than zero

observable.primary: Z3 check result values sat or unsat
secondary: model values for Boolean and integer SAT cases

pass: Boolean conjunction is SAT and model sets both variables true
commute and not-commute integer product constraints are UNSAT
five-cycle exclusion with sum at least three is UNSAT
push frame contradiction is UNSAT and popped solver returns SAT
direct p and not p contradiction is UNSAT
tautology p or not p is SAT
linear integer system model is x=7 and y=3
real x squared less than zero is UNSAT

graveyards.name: direct_boolean_contradiction
graveyards.change: assert p and not p in the same solver

graveyards.name: ill_formed_bool_int_and
graveyards.change: combine an Int expression and Bool expression through And
graveyards.expected_death: Z3 raises instead of constructing a valid formula

baselines.name: manual_boolean_truth_table
baselines.role: baseline for p and not p contradiction and p or not p tautology

baselines.name: manual_five_cycle_independent_set_bound
baselines.role: baseline that the maximum independent set of C5 has size 2

baselines.name: manual_linear_system_solution
baselines.role: baseline solving x+y=10 and x-y=4 as x=7, y=3

alternative_formulations: cvc5 QF_LIA and Boolean encoding of the same SAT/UNSAT fixtures
truth-table enumeration for the Boolean fixtures
integer linear programming formulation of the five-cycle exclusion bound
out_of_scope: no bridge, axis, engine, or scientific coupling claim
demotion_condition: Demote to blocked tool capability if z3 is unavailable, any SAT/UNSAT check fails, or strict receipt lint fails.
promotion_condition: May only support later z3 tool-lego or tool-tool packets after those packets provide their own admitted receipts.
next_lego_target: Use as a prerequisite receipt for bounded z3 proof micro packets.
blocked_until: No broader claim until a downstream packet cites this receipt and passes its own stage gate.
